description: Defines the AudioStreamBuilder class, a factory for creating and configuring AudioStream objects, including methods for setting performance modes, callbacks, privacy options, and validation.

classes.name: AudioStreamBuilder
classes.description: A factory class for constructing and configuring AudioStream instances with various parameters.

methods.name: setSharingModeMatchRequired
methods.description: Sets whether sharing mode matching is required for the stream.

methods.name: setPerformanceMode
methods.description: Sets the performance mode for the stream.

methods.name: setDataCallbackProc
methods.description: Sets the data callback function for the stream.

methods.name: setDataCallbackUserData
methods.description: Sets user data for the data callback.

methods.name: setErrorCallbackProc
methods.description: Sets the error callback function for the stream.

methods.name: setErrorCallbackUserData
methods.description: Sets user data for the error callback.

methods.name: setFramesPerDataCallback
methods.description: Sets the number of frames per data callback.

methods.name: setPrivacySensitiveRequest
methods.description: Configures privacy sensitivity for the stream.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an AudioStream object based on configured parameters.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the current configuration of the builder.

methods.name: logParameters
methods.description: Logs the current parameters of the builder.
